PRIMARY CARE NOTE   Date: 2026-03-18
56F, acute visit for symptom evaluation.

S:
Patient presents with two months of episodic wheezing and chest tightness, mostly on cold mornings and after climbing stairs at work, resolving within 10 minutes of rest. Occasional dry cough at night. Never smoker. Works evenings stocking shelves at a grocery store, about 20 hours per week, often around dust from boxes. History of colon cancer, s/p resection in 2022. Completed surveillance colonoscopy last year with her gastroenterologist and was told it was clear. Bowel habits regular. Mother with breast cancer. Mother with rheumatoid arthritis. Drinks about four cups of coffee daily. Sleep about 6 hours per night.

O:
BP 118/74, HR 78, RR 14, Temp 98.2 F, SpO2 98% on room air. BMI 27.
General: well appearing, in no acute distress.
HEENT: nasal mucosa normal, oropharynx clear.
CV: regular rate and rhythm, no murmur.
Lungs: clear to auscultation bilaterally at rest today.
Abdomen: well-healed midline surgical scar, soft, nontender, no masses.
Labs (point of care today): Hgb 11.9 g/dL, glucose 104 mg/dL fasting.

A/P:
1. Possible mild intermittent asthma; will trial albuterol. Albuterol inhaler 2 puffs as needed for wheezing or before exertion. Inhaler technique demonstrated. Recommended a dust mask at work. Spirometry scheduled for next visit.
2. Prediabetes, counseled on diet and exercise. A1c ordered today. Discussed walking 20 minutes on non-work days and reducing sugary drinks.
3. Anemia, stable on recheck. Continue oral iron. CBC and ferritin with next labs.
4. Health maintenance: mammogram is due given family history; order placed. Continue colon surveillance per gastroenterology schedule.

Follow up in 6 weeks to review labs and spirometry, sooner if breathing worsens.
